trial_court: Additional District Judge, H.M. Petition No. 793/2003
case_name: Ms. Neha Bhasin vs Sanjeev Kumar @ Monu
facts_of_case: The wife was kidnapped and forced to marry the husband. She alleged that she was under influence of drugs and did not understand anything. The trial court dismissed her petition seeking declaration that the marriage was void.

legal_principles.principle: A party cannot continue to agitate the same facts again and again as per their own convenience.
legal_principles.held: Since earlier petition was filed on the basis of some facts which was not prosecuted by the petitioner and it is not permissible for the petitioner to continue agitating the same facts again and again as per her own convenience.

legal_principles.principle: A party's consent to a marriage cannot be inferred as obtained with force or fraud solely based on the fact that they cooperated in quashing criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: As such, it is difficult to conclude that the consent of the petitioner to the said marriage on 20.2.2003 which was registered with Registrar of Marriages at Ghaziabad, U.P. on 21.02.2003 was obtained with force and fraud.

use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
arguing coercion and duress in a marriage
seeking annulment of a void marriage
